basis: v2 and a 20 ms diagnostic: an abrupt lethal kill releases the target's current at once, the common node jumps and new cells nucleate at the nearest free healthy places (no escape is possible through a -300 mV band); a gradual kill (-10 mV/s) produced no nucleation and the survivors widened (3.3 V: middle cell 58 -> 108 um)
P1_slow_recycle: slow death: no genuine nucleation (no new cell > 10 um from all earlier cells) during damage; the target's width is taken up by widening of existing cells; 3.3 V: N 3 -> 2 and stays; 5.0 V: the widened neighbour divides by itself (N back to 3)
P2_replace: 3.3 V: the -150 mV weak spot divides the widened neighbour (N back to 3); after healing a cell enters the vacated region
P3_eject: the target is carried to the end and dies in the slowly ramped sink without any genuine nucleation
P4_fragment: a slowly ramped central band cuts the target into two surviving pieces, without genuine nucleation
